_note: Starter question bank. Not seeded directly – Claude copies and tailors these into questions/<person>.json. Questions are spoken aloud, so keep each one short, warm and plain.

questions.text: What do you know about where your family comes from, and how they came to settle where you grew up?
Tell me about your father. What kind of person was he?
Tell me about your mother. What are your warmest memories of her?
What do you remember about your grandparents?
Was there a relative you were especially close to as a child? What made them special?
Is there a family story that was told again and again when you were young?
What is the very earliest thing you can remember?
Describe the home you grew up in. Walk me through it, room by room.
What was a normal day like for you when you were about eight or nine?
Who were your brothers, sisters, or the other children you grew up with? What were they like?
What games did you play, and who did you play them with?
What did your neighbourhood sound and smell like?
Were you ever in trouble as a child? What happened?
Tell me about your school. What was it like walking in on a normal morning?
Was there a teacher you still remember? Why them?
Who were your best friends at school, and what did you get up to together?
What were you good at, and what did you find hard?
What did you dream of becoming when you grew up?
What was it like being a teenager in those days?
What music, films, or fashions did you love when you were young?
When did you first feel like a grown-up?
Tell me about the first time you left home for a while. Where did you go?
What did your parents hope you would do with your life? Did you agree?
What was your very first job, and how did you get it?
Tell me about the work you spent most of your life doing.
What day at work are you proudest of?
Who taught you the most in your working life?
Was there a hard decision about work that changed the course of your life?
How did you meet the person you married? Tell me about the first time you saw them.
What made you realise they were the one?
Tell me about your wedding day. What do you remember most?
What were the first years together like? Where did you live?
What has kept the two of you together through the years?
What do you remember about the day your first child was born?
What was each of your children like when they were small?
What was the hardest part of being a parent, and what was the best part?
Is there a funny family moment that still makes you laugh?
What did you want most for your children?
Which dish takes you straight back to your childhood? Who made it?
How did your family celebrate festivals and special days?
Is there a tradition you kept going with your own family?
Tell me about a place you lived that truly felt like home.
What big events in the world do you remember living through? How did they touch your family?
Was there a time when money was tight? How did you manage?
What was the biggest move or change you ever made?
What has changed most in the world since you were young, and what do you miss?
What values did your parents pass on to you?
What has faith, or what you believe in, meant to you over the years?
Who do you admire most, and why?
Is there something you changed your mind about as you grew older?
What are you proudest of in your life?
What was the happiest time of your life?
What is the best advice anyone ever gave you?
What would you like your grandchildren to know about you?
If you could sit down with your younger self, what would you tell them?
How would you like to be remembered?
